notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, with the wire bore at the reference's measured offset, and the revised one draws the print fits listed in 710-002_SplitGearBottom.scad's header: the press clearance on the MR128 seat, the stub and the crown's Ø23 bore, the shoulders bored to the bearings' outer races, and the wire bore concentric. The dimensions are in that header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
